title: The email that ignored an unsubscribe
blurb: Suppression expired and hard bounces were retried.
prompt: A customer who unsubscribed received three more campaigns, because the draft kept suppression in an expiring cache, and a hard bounce was retried for a week. A timeout resend delivered duplicates with a fresh message id. Review it, fix it, and prove suppression is durable and retries are idempotent.
aiNote: The draft keeps suppression in a TTL cache, so an unsubscribe is forgotten after an hour, and it retries hard bounces and resends after timeouts under a new message id, delivering duplicates and ignoring terminal signals.
testIdea: Suppress a recipient and assert sends are refused after the cache TTL; return a hard bounce and assert exactly one relay attempt; time out a relay and assert the reconciliation uses the original message id.
followUps: Which bounces are terminal versus retryable?
How do you reconcile an unknown relay outcome?
What belongs in a merge variable allowlist?
